digest.component_or_area: store sync and push union guards
propositions: A stale clone reaching sync._union_merge with mismatched epoch must return without merging and preserve both local and remote refs unchanged
A stale clone reaching push.py non-fast-forward retry with mismatched epoch must return immediately without merge or re-push and leave both histories untouched
The epoch field in .store-compat.json must be a JSON string compared only for byte equality; non-string values are treated as corrupt and abort
The state matrix must distinguish record absence from epoch absence within a present record, and differentiate remote-ref-unreadable from file-absent in error messages
The guard at push.py must terminate the retry loop immediately on epoch mismatch and surface the push as not-completed, causing fsck to report DIVERGED not PUSH_PENDING
After a guard-aborted non-fast-forward push, local and remote tips remain byte-for-byte identical with zero merge invocations and zero further push attempts
